mapper.update: UPDATE GYE_ACCOUNT SET ACCOUNT_STATUS = 'RETIRED' WHERE GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND GYE_ACCOUNT_ID = #{accountId} AND ACCOUNT_STATUS = 'PENDING' AND REQUESTED_AT IS NOT NULL AND CONFIRMED_AT IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT A.GYE_ACCOUNT_ID, A.GROUP_ID, G.OWNER_ID, A.BANK_NAME, A.ACCOUNT_NO_ENC, A.ACCOUNT_NO_LAST4, A.KEY_VER, A.VERIFY_STATUS, A.ACCOUNT_STATUS FROM GYE_ACCOUNT A JOIN GYE_GROUP G ON G.GROUP_ID = A.GROUP_ID WHERE A.GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND A.GYE_ACCOUNT_ID = #{accountId} AND A.ACCOUNT_STATUS = 'PENDING' AND A.REQUESTED_AT IS NOT NULL AND A.CONFIRMED_AT IS NULL

SELECT A.BANK_NAME,
CASE WHEN REGEXP_LIKE( A.ACCOUNT_NO_LAST4, '^[0-9]{4}$' ) THEN '*****' || A.ACCOUNT_NO_LAST4 ELSE NULL END AS ACCOUNT_MASKED,
C.AGREED_YN AS MY_AGREED_YN
FROM GYE_ACCOUNT A
LEFT JOIN CONSENT C ON C.CONSENT_TYPE = 'ACCOUNT' AND C.TARGET_ID = A.GYE_ACCOUNT_ID AND C.GROUP_ID = A.GROUP_ID AND C.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
WHERE A.GROUP_ID = #{groupId} AND A.GYE_ACCOUNT_ID = #{accountId} AND A.ACCOUNT_STATUS = 'PENDING' AND A.REQUESTED_AT IS NOT NULL AND A.CONFIRMED_AT IS NULL
